web.title: Cluely Review (2026): Pricing, Breach, Honest Verdict
web.description:
[Proof](https://www.interviewcoder.co/#proof-section) [Pricing](https://www.interviewcoder.co/#pricing) [Help](https://www.interviewcoder.co/help) [How it works](https://www.interviewcoder.co/still_working) [Leaked Questions\
NEW](https://www.interviewcoder.co/questions)

[Login](https://www.interviewcoder.co/signin)

![](https://www.interviewcoder.co/_next/image?url=%2Fheader%2FVector.svg&w=32&q=75) Download for free

![Menu](https://www.interviewcoder.co/_next/image?url=%2Flanding-page%2Fopen-menu.svg&w=48&q=75)

Cluely is the biggest name in the "invisible AI assistant" category, and it got there the loud way. The company was founded in 2025 by Chungin "Roy" Lee, Neel Shanmugam, and Alex Chen, after Lee and Shanmugam were suspended from Columbia University for building a Chrome extension that fed AI answers during technical interviews ( [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cluely)). Cluely launched on April 20, 2025 under the tagline "Cheat on Everything," with a launch video showing Lee using the tool on a date to fabricate his age, knowledge, and career. It pulled 70,000 signups in the first week ( [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cluely)). Whatever you think of the marketing, it worked: Cluely now draws tens of thousands of branded searches a month.

Since then the product has quietly changed shape. By late April 2025 the company removed explicit references to cheating, and by November 2025 it had repositioned as a standard AI meeting assistant going after the same buyers as Otter.ai and Granola ( [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cluely), [SF Standard](https://sfstandard.com/2025/11/20/san-francisco-s-controversial-startup-moving-new-york/)). Today cluely.com calls itself "Meeting AI that helps during the call, not after" — a desktop overlay that watches your screen and listens to your mic, then feeds you talking points, summaries, and answers in real time ( [cluely.com/pricing](https://cluely.com/pricing)).

Cluely competes with us in the broad sense. Read this with that bias in mind. Every factual claim about Cluely below links to a source we pulled this week — the live pricing page, Wikipedia, TechCrunch, a16z, and independent reviews. Check our work.

## Quick Verdict
Cluely is a real, well-funded product that does one thing better than almost anyone: it stays hidden during a screen share. It is backed by a $15M Series A from Andreessen Horowitz, it has genuine momentum, and as a general meeting copilot it is fast and cheap at $19.99/month ( [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2025/06/20/cluely-a-startup-that-helps-cheat-on-everything-raises-15m-from-a16z/), [cluely.com/pricing](https://cluely.com/pricing)). It is held back by three things, all documented below: a 2025 breach that exposed data on 83,000+ users, a "general assistant" design that reviewers say handles coding interviews poorly, and a brand so famous that recruiter detection tools train against it by name ( [Medium](https://medium.com/@nullwalker/how-cheating-app-cluely-got-hacked-leaking-83-000-users-data-9ac572ff3d00), [LinkJob](https://www.linkjob.ai/hub/cluely-review/)).

## Key Facts
| Fact | Detail | Source |
|-|-|-|
| Company | Founded 2025, SF (moving to NYC late 2025); founders Roy Lee, Neel Shanmugam, Alex Chen | [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cluely), [SF Standard](https://sfstandard.com/2025/11/20/san-francisco-s-controversial-startup-moving-new-york/) |
| Funding | $5.3M seed (Apr 2025) + $15M Series A led by a16z (Jun 2025) = $20.3M total | [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cluely), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2025/06/20/cluely-a-startup-that-helps-cheat-on-everything-raises-15m-from-a16z/) |
| What it is now | Real-time AI meeting assistant: live notes, talking points, summaries, follow-ups | [cluely.com/pricing](https://cluely.com/pricing) |
| Platforms | Desktop app, macOS + Windows; overlay hidden from Zoom, Meet, Teams screen share | [cluely.com/pricing](https://cluely.com/pricing) |
| Free plan | Starter $0 — limited AI responses/day, limited note-taking, upload up to 3 files | [cluely.com/pricing](https://cluely.com/pricing) |
| Pro | $19.99/month — unlimited AI messages, unlimited notes, latest models, priority support | [cluely.com/pricing](https://cluely.com/pricing) |
| Pro + Undetectability | $149.99/month — adds "completely hidden to meeting screen sharing software" | [cluely.com/pricing](https://cluely.com/pricing) |
| Lifetime option | None — subscription only | [cluely.com/pricing](https://cluely.com/pricing) |
| AI models | "Access to the latest AI models" — specific models not named on the pricing page | [cluely.com/pricing](https://cluely.com/pricing) |
| Data breach | Mid-2025: 83,000+ users; personal data, interview transcripts, screenshots exposed | [Medium](https://medium.com/@nullwalker/how-cheating-app-cluely-got-hacked-leaking-83-000-users-data-9ac572ff3d00), [BlueDot](https://www.bluedothq.com/blog/cluely-review) |

## What Cluely Does Well
A fair review concedes real strengths, and Cluely has several.

**The stealth is the best in the category.** This is the honest headline. Cluely's overlay renders through low-level GPU hooks rather than a normal window, so Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams do not capture it during a screen share — the people on your call cannot see it ( [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cluely)).

**As a general meeting copilot, it is fast and cheap.** For sales calls, standups, and everyday meetings, $19.99/month for unlimited AI responses, live notes, and follow-up drafting is competitive pricing, and reviewers find the real-time assistance useful in high-pressure moments — context-aware talking points and summaries delivered while the call is still happening ( [BlueDot](https://www.bluedothq.com/blog/cluely-review), [cluely.com/pricing](https://cluely.com/pricing)). The Pro tier undercuts a lot of the interview-copilot field on monthly price.

**It is genuinely well funded and not anonymous.**

**The free tier lets you try before paying.** The Starter plan is genuinely $0 with a capped number of AI responses per day, so you can install it and see whether the overlay and the answers fit your workflow before spending anything ( [cluely.com/pricing](https://cluely.com/pricing)).

## Where It Falls Short
### A general assistant is not an interview specialist
Cluely is now built to help with "everything" — meetings, sales, homework, calls. That breadth is a real cost in a coding interview.

## Cluely vs Interview Coder
|  | Cluely | Interview Coder |
|-|-|-|
| Focus | General assistant: meetings, sales, calls, "everything" ( [cluely.com/pricing](https://cluely.com/pricing)) | Coding interviews. That's the product |
| AI models | "Latest AI models" — not named on the pricing page ( [cluely.com/pricing](https://cluely.com/pricing)) | Coding answers run on Claude Sonnet 4.6, Anthropic's latest Sonnet — named |
| Pricing model | Subscription only: $19.99 or $149.99/mo, no lifetime option ( [cluely.com/pricing](https://cluely.com/pricing)) | Free $0, Monthly Pro $299, or Lifetime Pro $799 one-time |
| Stealth | Best-in-class screen-share invisibility ( [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cluely)); also the most-targeted by detection tools ( [LinkJob](https://www.linkjob.ai/hub/cluely-review/)) | 20+ stealth features; no "100%" claims, because nobody can honestly make them |
| Proof | a16z-backed, well funded ( [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2025/06/20/cluely-a-startup-that-helps-cheat-on-everything-raises-15m-from-a16z/)); 2025 breach of 83K+ users ( [Medium](https://medium.com/@nullwalker/how-cheating-app-cluely-got-hacked-leaking-83-000-users-data-9ac572ff3d00)) | 100K+ users; face-shown real-interview recordings as proof |

## Verdict
**Pick Cluely if** you want a general-purpose, real-time meeting copilot and the coding interview is not your main worry. For sales calls, standups, and everyday meetings, its overlay is the best in the business at staying off a shared screen, $19.99/month for unlimited use is fair, and a16z's backing means it is here to stay ( [cluely.com/pricing](https://cluely.com/pricing), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2025/06/20/cluely-a-startup-that-helps-cheat-on-everything-raises-15m-from-a16z/)).

That is the case we built for: a desktop app focused on live technical interviews, coding answers running on Claude Sonnet 4.6 rather than an unnamed "latest model," 20+ stealth features without a "100% undetectable" promise we can't back, and a $799 one-time option so there is no renewal to manage. Where Cluely gives you a context-free snippet, the product is built to give you a solution you can explain when the interviewer asks why.

# Best AI Interview Assistant Tools in 2026
## How do the best AI interview tools compare?
| Tool | Focus | Real-time or prep | Platforms | Pricing | Ethical stance | Privacy |
|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|
| **Cluely** | Live answers + meeting notes | Mostly real-time | Mac, Windows, iOS | Free; Pro $19.99/mo; Pro + Undetectability $149.99/mo | Cheating-origin, now repositioned; sells undetectability | Cloud; reported 2025 breach of 83k+ users |
| **Interview Coder** | Coding-round answers | Real-time | Mac, Windows | Free; Pro $299/mo; Lifetime $799 | Explicitly stealth, no coaching pretense | Cloud |

Sources: [Cluely pricing](https://cluely.com/pricing), [Interview Coder](https://www.interviewcoder.co/), [Sensei AI](https://www.senseicopilot.com/), [Final Round AI pricing](https://www.finalroundai.com/), [LockedIn AI pricing](https://www.lockedinai.com/pricing), [Beyz via SaaSworthy](https://www.saasworthy.com/product/beyz-ai), [Hedy pricing](https://www.hedy.ai/pricing/). Prices were read from each vendor’s live page in June 2026 and change often, so re-check before you buy.

## How does Cluely work and what does it cost?
Cluely is the category’s defining stealth-then-pivot case. It runs a real-time desktop overlay that listens to your audio and watches your screen during meetings, then feeds you live answers through an invisible window. Its homepage now pitches an [AI assistant for meetings](https://cluely.com/) with perfect notes, while still describing the overlay as undetectable.

The backstory matters for your trust decision. Cluely was founded in 2025 by the same people behind Interview Coder, who got suspended from Columbia over it, and it launched with explicit “cheat on everything” marketing before softening the message. It raised a reported $15M from Andreessen Horowitz, and a [mid-2025 breach reportedly exposed data on 83,000+ users](https://tldv.io/blog/cluely-review/), including interview transcripts and screenshots. That last detail is the whole privacy argument against any cloud-stealth tool: your most sensitive interview data lives on someone else’s servers.

Pricing, per [Cluely’s own page](https://cluely.com/pricing): free Starter, Pro at $19.99/mo for unlimited responses and notes, and Pro + Undetectability at $149.99/mo, which adds screen-share invisibility. The undetectability is the upsell, which tells you what they think they’re actually selling.

## How does Final Round AI compare?
It offers AI mock interviews, a resume builder, performance reports, and an “Interview Copilot” that gives real-time guidance over Zoom, Meet, Teams, and coding platforms like LeetCode and HackerRank, across 26+ languages.

The catch is that it also markets a desktop [Stealth Mode billed as “100% Invisible & Undetectable”](https://www.finalroundai.com/), which runs silently during screen sharing. Use only its mock-interview and resume features and you’re squarely in legitimate-prep territory; the stealth copilot is where you’d be making the riskier bet.

Trust signal: 3.9 out of 5 on Trustpilot from 255 reviews, with billing and AI-quality complaints common. Check the live price before you pay.

## What about LockedIn AI and Sensei AI?
It captures system audio so it works across Zoom, Teams, Meet, and Webex, and adds mock interviews and post-call scoring. Its stance is mixed: it markets a “Stealth Mode” with aliased process names and global hotkeys as undetectable, yet [reviewers note that its browser extension is visible to interviewers](https://interviewsidekick.com/blog/lockedin-ai-review), which creates a two-tier stealth story. On pricing, [LockedIn publishes its plans](https://www.lockedinai.com/pricing): as of June 2026, roughly $54.99/mo for the general copilot, $119.99/mo for the Professional tier with Stealth Mode, and a $999.50 lifetime plan (listed at half off $1,999).

It generates structured answers live, tailored to your resume, and adds a resume builder and coding copilot. On pricing: free 15-minute sessions, then Pro at $89/mo or $24/mo billed annually, with unlimited sessions, hands-free mode, and 30+ languages.

If you want the second-language angle without a stealth pitch, **Beyz AI** leans into tone and clarity coaching with live translation, at $49.99/mo down to $24.99/mo semi-annual.

## How is Hedy different from the cheating-first tools?
It doesn’t ship a stealth mode, an “undetectable” claim, or screen-share evasion.

It also suggests sharp questions to ask back. For in-person interviews, where you won’t be staring at your phone, the value is the prep beforehand and an honest post-interview review where you ask Hedy how you did.

Pricing: free for 5 hours a month, Pro at $12.99/mo or $99.99/yr, Lifetime $299.

## Frequently asked questions
### How much does Cluely cost?
Per Cluely’s own pricing page, it offers a free Starter tier, Pro at $19.99/mo (unlimited AI responses and notes), and Pro + Undetectability at $149.99/mo, which adds screen-share invisibility. Pricing verified June 2026; re-check before buying.

web.title: Cluely Review in 2026: Pros, Cons and How It Compares
web.description:
Promotion title

Promotion description

[Button Text](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/cluely-review-pros-cons#)

Cluely is a desktop AI overlay app that displays real-time answers during live interviews and video calls. Starting at $20/month for its Pro tier or $75/month for the stealth overlay that hides from Zoom and Meet, Cluely is the most technically sophisticated live interview assistant on the market in 2026 but it comes with serious tradeoffs: a documented data breach exposing 83,000 users, a growing detection arms race, and zero preparation functionality for candidates who want to improve. If you need a complete platform covering practice, coaching, and live support, read to the end of this comparison.

**Quick Answer**

- Cluely's stealth overlay costs $75/month, not $20; the basic Pro tier overlay is visible to screen-sharing software
- In mid-2025, Cluely suffered a breach exposing 83,000 users' data after leaving an admin password in a public GitHub repo

## What Is Cluely and How Does It Work?
Cluely is a real-time AI overlay for desktop computers that reads your screen and listens to your audio during live interviews and meetings, then surfaces AI-generated responses in a floating window only you can see. The tool was originally built as Interview Coder by Columbia undergraduates Roy Lee and Neel Shanmugam in early 2025. When Columbia suspended both students in March 2025, they rebranded as Cluely, raised $5.3 million within three weeks, and launched with the tagline "cheat on everything." The company raised at an approximate $120 million valuation by June 2025, backed by Abstract Ventures, Susa Ventures, and Andreessen Horowitz.

This low-level rendering approach makes the floating window invisible to Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams screen sharing, but only on the $75/month Pro plus Undetectability tier. The app uses OCR to read on-screen text, captures system audio via speech-to-text, and feeds that context to an LLM to generate suggestions in near real time.

## Cluely Key Features in 2026
### iOS App and Desktop Widget Mode
In 2026, Cluely launched an iOS app and a Desktop Widget mode, allowing AI assistance on mobile for in-person interviews or presentations. The Mobile plan is priced at $8 per week, which adds roughly $32/month on top of any desktop subscription.

## Cluely Pros: What Works Well
- **Industry-leading stealth technology:** The GPU-level overlay is the most technically advanced approach in the category and genuinely defeats screen-share detection on major video platforms when on the Undetectability tier.
- **Fast setup with a real free trial:** The 7-day free trial on Pro gives you a genuine evaluation window, and getting started requires no technical configuration beyond downloading the desktop app.
- **Broad use case flexibility:** Beyond interviews, Cluely works for sales calls, meetings, presentations, and research sessions, making it useful for professionals beyond just job seekers.
- **Access to frontier AI models:** Pro and higher plans include GPT-4.1 and Claude 3.7 access, which produces higher-quality suggestions than tools locked to older models.
- **Lowest base price for live assistance:** The $20/month Pro tier is among the lowest prices for unlimited live AI assistance, assuming you do not need the stealth overlay.

## Cluely Pricing: How Much Does It Cost?
Cluely uses a four-tier pricing structure as of 2026. The **Starter (Free)** tier limits users to 5 AI responses per day with 100-character output caps, functioning only as a demo. The **Pro tier at $20/month** unlocks unlimited AI responses and access to the latest language models, but the overlay remains detectable by screen-share software. The **Pro plus Undetectability tier at $75/month** adds the GPU-level invisible overlay that defeats Zoom, Meet, Teams, and Webex screen-capture detection. The **Enterprise tier at $200/month** adds SSO, RBAC, post-call analytics, and custom integrations. A separate **Mobile plan at $8/week** covers the iOS app for in-person scenarios. Note that some third-party sources cite the Undetectability tier at $149.99/month so verify current pricing directly on Cluely's website.

## Cluely vs Final Round AI: Head-to-Head
| Feature | Cluely | Final Round AI |
|-|-|-|
| Live interview assistance | Yes (Pro tier) | Yes (Interview Copilot) |
| Stealth overlay | Yes ($75/mo tier only) | Discreet interface, no screen-capture bypass needed |
| Mock interview practice | No | Yes: company-specific tracks |
| STAR-method coaching | No | Yes: structured behavioral coaching |
| Coding interview support | Yes: core strength | Yes: coding tracks available |
| Data security history | 83,000-user breach in 2025 | No known breach |
| Pricing (entry live tier) | $20/mo (detectable overlay) | Included in platform plans |
| Company-specific prep | No | Yes: Google, Amazon, Deloitte tracks |

## Is Cluely Worth It in 2026?
Cluely is worth considering if your only goal is to get through a specific technical interview using real-time AI assistance and you are willing to pay $75/month for the stealth overlay. The GPU-level invisibility technology is genuinely impressive, and for a one-time high-stakes technical interview, the short-term cost may feel justified. That is the honest case for the product.

The honest case against it is more substantial. The 2025 data breach is not a minor incident. Beyond security, Cluely creates a skills ceiling: every interview you pass with AI assistance is an interview where you did not practice or improve, which compounds over time as roles become more senior and the gap between AI-assisted performance and actual ability becomes more visible.

For candidates who want both live support and genuine skill development, Final Round AI's Interview Copilot provides real-time assistance during live interviews alongside a full practice and coaching ecosystem. You can run [AI mock interviews](https://www.finalroundai.com/ai-mock-interview) with company-specific question tracks before the real thing, then use live support during the actual interview, addressing the full preparation-to-performance pipeline rather than just the final moment. Cluely's value is a single-purpose tool that only makes sense if you never plan to build real skills, which is a limiting long-term strategy in any career.

## Alternatives to Cluely
Final Round AI offers the most complete platform in 2026, combining live interview copilot support with mock practice, STAR coaching, resume building, and company-specific preparation tracks. It is the best option for candidates who want to improve their actual skills alongside getting live support. For communication delivery coaching specifically, Yoodli offers speech analysis at $8/month, though it provides no live interview support during actual interviews.
